investorHighlights.label: Reporting speed
investorHighlights.detail: Site updates become engineer-verified reports, approval tasks, PDFs, and management KPIs.

investorHighlights.label: Approval discipline
investorHighlights.detail: Every report, material request, document, invoice, payment, and change has a visible route.

investorHighlights.label: Document trust
investorHighlights.detail: Field staff see the approved version while managers keep revision history and superseded warnings.

investorHighlights.label: Cost visibility
investorHighlights.detail: Manpower, material consumption, tool movements, supplier invoices, payments, and P&L connect to field activity.

investorHighlights.label: Mobile adoption
investorHighlights.detail: Phone-first updates, autosave, photo queue, and offline drafts make the process practical on site.

painPointComparisons.before: Supervisors share WhatsApp photos and notes that managers manually chase later.
painPointComparisons.after: A guided report captures attendance, OT, materials, safety, WIR, delays, photos, and attachments.
painPointComparisons.impact: Fewer missing reports, faster PM approval, and a reliable contractual record.

painPointComparisons.before: Approvals sit in chat threads or email inboxes with unclear ownership and no SLA.
painPointComparisons.after: The portal assigns approvers by role/project, tracks SLA, reminds at 24h, and escalates at 48h.
painPointComparisons.impact: Decisions are visible, reject reasons are retained, and overrides are audited.

painPointComparisons.before: Drawings, WIRs, MIRs, delivery notes, and invoices live in folders with version confusion.
painPointComparisons.after: Each document has metadata, approval status, revision history, active/superseded state, and search.
painPointComparisons.impact: Field teams stop using outdated files while management keeps complete history.

painPointComparisons.before: Store ledgers, tool locations, stock requests, supplier terms, and consumption are split across spreadsheets and WhatsApp follow-ups.
painPointComparisons.after: Materials and tagged tools move through request, approval, reserve, issue/transfer, return/consume, and current-location tracking.
painPointComparisons.impact: Teams can locate tools, protect warehouse/site stock, and see low-stock or cost exposure earlier.

businessFlow.title: 1. Project baseline
businessFlow.detail: Create project code, BOQ, milestones, members, and target dates.

businessFlow.title: 2. Site update
businessFlow.detail: Capture attendance, overtime, location, progress, safety, materials, and photos.

businessFlow.title: 3. Technical verification
businessFlow.detail: Validate work quality, WIR status, quantities, blockers, and next-day plan.

businessFlow.title: 4. Approval control
businessFlow.detail: Approve, reject with reason, or trigger escalation based on role and SLA.

businessFlow.title: 5. Company record
businessFlow.detail: Update KPIs, generate PDF, email stakeholders, log audit trail, and refresh documents/costs.
